# Harinarayan Maniyanthara Rajesh

> Software engineer. Builds production-ready systems in Go — backend services, kiosk OSes, edge AI, computer vision. Maintains the noss RSS package for Debian. 9× hackathon winner.

Personal portfolio and project showcase for Harinarayan Maniyanthara Rajesh.

Core Tech Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, Linux, Docker, Systemd, QEMU, SvelteKit, TensorFlow, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Raspberry Pi, MQTT, Git, CI/CD, Cloudflare Tunnels.

## About & Overview

- [Personal Portfolio](https://hari.laddu.cc): Personal portfolio site and showcase of projects, experience, and contact details.

## Projects

- [SecureBox Vault](https://hari.laddu.cc/#projects): Stateless kiosk OS with QEMU sandbox isolation and encrypted Cloudflare Tunnel transfers. Built to prevent sensitive data leakage.
- [Kesla](https://hari.laddu.cc/#projects): EV dashboard OS booting in <3s on Raspberry Pi. 3D gesture navigation via MediaPipe. systemd-optimized Chromium kiosk.
- [Veekshan](https://hari.laddu.cc/#projects): Natural-language search for surveillance footage. NLP-to-computer-vision pipeline running on local edge hardware.
- [Mishran](https://hari.laddu.cc/#projects): Multi-camera live production system. Syncs phone video feeds, AI shot selection via n8n-orchestrated agents.
- [EyeTap](https://hari.laddu.cc/#projects): Gaze-controlled interface using OpenCV/dlib at 30 FPS. Hands-free computer control via Android WebSocket streaming.

## Experience

- [Debian Package Maintainer](https://qa.debian.org/developer.php?login=harinarayanmr2%40gmail.com): Maintainer for the noss RSS/Atom feed aggregator package for Debian (Oct 2025–Present). Handles packaging, dependency updates, bug fixes, and security patches following Debian policy.
